spots.label: the counter
spots.description: A flour-dusted oak counter with a brass till.

norms.reaction: Not in my bakery! Take that outside.

sides.description: A green door with a brass bell above it.
The bakery's green door; it smells of bread.
A heavy wooden hatch set into the floor.
A ladder leads up to the hatch.

factions.label: the Bakers Guild
factions.description: The guild sets fair prices for bread in town.

factions.label: the Night Market
factions.description: Traders who sell after dark, few questions asked.

events.label: the harvest fair
events.description: Stalls fill the square for three days.

stages.description: My ring slipped off while I was kneading. Please look around the cellar.
You found it! I cannot thank you enough.

persona.summary: I have baked bread here for twenty years, and I know every regular by name.

services.label: fresh bread
services.description: A loaf of the day's bread.

goals.description: I want my rye to win a ribbon at the harvest fair.
Honestly, I just want my ring back.

relationships.name: Tovin
relationships.description: Tovin is my younger brother; he keeps the old cistern.

secrets.reveal: Between us, I owe the mill for three months of flour.
secrets.cover: My accounts are in perfect order, thank you.

secrets.reveal: The cellar has a second door to the old tunnels.

variants: The new taxes hit small bakeries hardest.
Taxes again? Do not get me started.

listeners.name: Arin
recent: Arin; thank you for telling me your name.

records.text: The traveller paid for rye bread with a silver coin.
